findings: 434 of 660 Shorts (66%) put a scripture reference on the first frame, which the authoring prompt forbids: a reference is not a reason for a stranger to stay.
Every first frame is the same composition — 660 of 660 are a scene plate with three stacked lines of type. Nothing about the frame has ever varied, so nothing about it has ever been tested.
A stranger must read a median of 15 words on that frame before hearing a word. The decision they are making takes about one second.
not_claimed: that one first-frame composition earns more stays than another. Twelve Shorts could be matched to their spec on 25 November 2026; that cannot separate two compositions, and the module says so rather than picking one.
